items.name: db-migration-safety
items.title: DB Migration Safety
items.description: Review or write a database schema migration with production safety as the bar, checking locks, table rewrites, backfills, expand-contract deploy order, index creation, and rollback for Postgres, MySQL, and common ORMs. Use when adding or reviewing a migration, dropping or renaming columns, or adding constraints or indexes to large tables.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
